# Nick Rae

> Commercial pilot and aviation workbook author based in Merced, CA. Publishing FAA-aligned pilot study workbooks on Amazon KDP while building side income to fund flight hours toward a flying career.

## About

Nick Rae is a Commercial Instrument Multi-Engine rated pilot with 391.3 flight hours, working toward a 500-hour planning threshold and eventually the experience required for ATP certification. His main public product lane is FAA-aligned aviation study material on Amazon KDP, including Clearance to Confidence: VFR Radio Calls Workbook. He documents the Flight Funded experiment at nickrae.net. OpenClaw is a retired runtime; the dated playbook remains available as a background digital product, not the primary offer.

## Current Revenue Proof

- Reconciled KDP tracking at August 2026 month-end: 157 full-catalog books and 149 aviation units. The August aviation dashboard proof shows 27 paid units, $235.09 USD + €24.64 EUR in estimated royalties, 0 refunds, and 1,187 KENP; March-August aviation tracking is $1,282.32 USD + €71.47 EUR + A$9.49 in dashboard-estimated royalties, not settled payouts. Amazon Ads scale remains HOLD until same-window Campaign, Search Term, Targeting, and Placement evidence proves otherwise.
- Legacy Kalshi weather hypotheses were closed on August 27, 2026 after failed market-relative and executable-evidence gates; evidence is preserved, legacy collectors are paused, and live trading is off. Any newer research is separate and unproven, not income or live readiness. WeatherNext remains parked.
